brewery.brewery_description: New Zealand Brewing Company taking nothing seriously except making bigger tasting beers!

beer.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy

beer.beer_description: Our hazy, unfiltered IPA. Using a stupid amount of American hops and an english ale yeast. This beer is extremely juicy and aromatic. Rip the Lid off one!
Mosaic and Citra Hopped. Lower in alcohol than our usual Hazy IPAs and stupidly easy to drink. Like pouring smiles on your brain

Our signi-chur beer. This is NZ hops in a bottle or glass. A tropical hop fruit salad if you will. A refreshing bitterness that makes you want to come back for another sip or gulp. This beer is all about having a great flavour packed bigger tasting beer and enjoying the churness of good friends and family. Chur! 

ALC/VOL: 5.5%
IBU 40​
HOPS : Pacific Jade, NZ Cascade, Nelson Sauvin and Riwaka
MALT : Pale Malt, Munich, Pale Wheat, Carahells

Available on tap and bottled.

FOOD MATCHING : Fish and Chips, seafood,Thai food, anything with a little bit of spice, sausage rolls, cheerios and cheese and pineapple on toothpicks.

This here beer is for all y’all with a henkerin’ fir freedom, freedom to enjoy all them there hops. We done used good ol’ malts and gussied it up wit loads of granny-slappin’ good ’murican hops. Pick up ya britches, get ya clob hoppers on and enjoy this here ’murica pale ale. YEEHAW!

It tastes like freedom and loose gun laws!

ALC/VOL: 6.0%
IBU 50​
HOPS : Columbus, Centennial Simcoe and Amarillo
MALT : Pale Malt, Munich, pale crystal

Available on tap and bottled.

FOOD MATCHING : Buffalo wings, hotdogs, chilli, mac and cheese

American IPA dedicated to Dumping Donald Trump. Well it did not work but but we got a pretty good beer out of it. An American IPA that was also layered with US and NZ hop that act as a hoppy protest vote!

Mosaic Single Hop Hazy IPA 
Winner Trophy for Best IPA in New Zealand at the 2019 Brewers Guild of New Zealand Awards!

Milk stout infused with chocolate malt, Dutch Cocoa powder and Cocoa nibs. Vanilla for good measure. Just like a chocolate milkshake only beery.

ALC/VOL: 5.5%
IBU 40​
HOPS : Pacific Jade
MALT : Pale Malt, Munich, Pale Wheat, oats, Pale Crystal, Medium Crystal, pale chocolate, dark chocolate, roasted barley 
Other: Lactose, vanilla, dutch cocoa powder and cocoa nibs.

Available on tap and can.

FOOD MATCHING : Chocolate, chocolate and more chocolate
Our India Pale Ale with Citra, Azacca and El Dorado hops over a lovely malt cushion. Sometimes all you need is something hoppy. This beers are for those times. To be fair most times are those times

All tall people play basketball right? I always got told to stand tall and be proud of your height. Well for this beer I stand tall and am proud of our hops. This beer is based on delicious West Coast style IPA's but with a kiwi twist. It has a light malt base that is layered with big american hops (and a bit of Kiwi hops for good measure). It is big and tropical, piney and all sorts of lovely hoppy flavours). If you want some hop and basketball puns just read the bottle. 

ABV: 6.5%
HOPS: Pacific Jade, Mosiac, Centennial, Citra and Nelson Sauvin
MALT: Pale Malt, Pale Crystal, Carapils

Available in Keg and Bottle

beer.beer_name: Hopped Up On Pils - NZ Pilsner
beer.beer_description:
The New Zealand Pilsner is a beautiful thing. It takes the crispness and freshing qualities of a Pilsner and adds the flavours and aromas of an NZ Pilsner into the mix. This beer has the qualities of a pilsner but the big aromatics of NZ hops like an IPA. This beer is one that people new to craft beer will love but enough hops to satisfy people who are dedicated hop heads.

ALC/VOL 5%
HOPS: Pacific Jade, Motueka, and Riwaka 
MALT: Pilsner Malt, Carapils

Available in Keg on tap, can and bottle

FOOD MATCHING : Roast Chicken, Baked Salmon, Chips (chippies or fries), garlic prawns.
Peach Sour. Hazy as fuck, uses 200kg of Golden Queen Peaches on top of a Kettle Soured Pale malt and wheat malt base. Impeach that idiot!
Never let a hopportunity pass you by. This one combines a crazy amount of our favourite hops, fruit, dank, bitter, everything you want in a double IPA!

Nashville inspired Mosaic Hopped Hazy IPA. Nashville is a inspiring and eclectic city. We thought it was best represented by a hazy mosaic IPA... a punchbowl of flavours that feels like there is always live music playing in your mouth

Well you wanted a Hazy IPA, that is what you have here in your hot little hand. We have combined some of our all time favourite hops: Citra, Mosaic, El Dorado and Galaxy to bring you a medley of soft juicy flavours and aromas. We put the good things in so you can wear the something hazy grin.
Fresh Hop NZ IPA. Made with Fresh Hop Nelson Sauvin and Cascade hops. One representing Cheech the other Chong coming together and blazing it up right nice!

Hey, careful man, there's a Beverage here!

Call this beverage what you want: The Dude, his Dudeness, Duder or El Dudarino, if you are not into the whole brevity thing.
This Russian Imperial White Stout is made with Cold Brew Coffee from our mates at Harpoon
in Dunedin and Tahitian Vanilla Beans to really
tie the beer together. This beer might be a little
out of its element. It's pale but tastes like coffee, chocolate, and vanilla, but close your eyes (think of bowling) and you may just taste something big and dark.
So, enjoy this White Russian, in beer form, and take 'er easy. The dude always does.

PS shut the fuck up Donny!

Brewed for annual West Coast IPA Challenge The Malthouse 2020. Using English Golden Promise Malt and loaded it with Simcoe, Mosaic and the new (and finally) named hop Nectaron (formally Hort 4337). Along with kettle and whirlpool hops we have done a massive 20g/L dry hop. Giving you pineapple, stonefruit and piney flavours. All work and no hops makes Churly a dull boy. Well a lot of work and a lot of hops have gone into the beer so we hope you enjoy!
Maple Syrup Imperial Stout

beer.beer_name: Dreams of Green - Hazy Double IPA
beer.beer_style: IPA - Imperial / Double New England / Hazy
beer.beer_description: Collab with our buddies at Gweilo beer, Hazy Double IPA with Mosaic and Hort 4337 (Now called Nectaron)

Coconut, cocoa nib brown ale. This beer was originally brewed for Beervana's festive beer 2014. We picked up a gold medal and best in class trophy for it. It has been described as a macaroon, a liquid lamington, a bounty bar in a beer. It is a desert beer without being too sweet. It was a crowd favorite and one of the biggest selling beers at Beervana again in 2015.


This beer is not the easiest to make so we will likely only make it once a year (if that). So if you see one snap it up.

ABV 6%
HOPS: Pacific Jade
MALT: Pale Malt, chocolate malt, pale chocolate malt, brown malt, pale crystal, medium crystal, oats, golden syrup
Other: Coconut, Cocoa nibs, vanilla pods

FOOD MATCHING: Macaroons, dark chocolate, self saucing pudding. Or even those really freshly backed cookies you get from Ma Higgins.

​NB no longer in season

In Ya Face Double IPA is not here to fornicate with arachnids. This beer contains a massive amount of American hops, which like all good Americans will get right up In Ya Face!

ABV: 8%
Hops: Pacific Jade, Mosaic, Citra, Nelson Sauvin and Riwaka
Hazy IPA here to fight crime! Citra, Mosaic, Taiheke and Sabro!
Tropical Hazy IPA

Let me tell you something my friend, hops are a dangerous thing, hops can drive a person insane, got no use on the inside, better get used to that. It comes down to a simple choice. Get busy hopping or get busy…. Well not hopping. That’s goddamn right! Remember hops are a good thing, maybe the best of things, and good things never die. In honour of what may be the best movie ever made we make this West Coast IPA using our favourite NZ, Aussie and US hops. Malty, but dry and bitter, everything you could want in a West Coast IPA. I hope these hops were as green as they have been in my dreams. I hope...

Our very first imperial stout was a big one. Hannah and Andrew bought back 20kg of Vientamese coffee from our honeymoon and decided to make a big imperial stout out of it. We fell in love with Vietnam the people the food and the coffee. This is pretty much Vietnamese coffee in beer form! Using 10 different malts and a lot of coffee. vô!

Packed with a bunch of Behemoth's favourite NZ & US hops it's bursting at the seams with juicy, tropical flavours. It's as palatable as it is sessionable, making it the ideal choice for any occasion that has you reaching for a cold one. Whether you're relaxing or just enjoying some much needed downtime, dive into this Haze Juice and savour the best of what a Behemoth Hazy IPA has to offer!
Tropical version of Chur NZ Pale Ale made with Mango, Pineapple and Passion fruit

beer.beer_name: Stop Hop & Roll Fresh Hop Cold IPA
beer.beer_description: made with fresh hop Riwaka and Nelson Sauvin, bringing a burst of zesty lime, passionfruit and crushed gooseberry, layered with ripe white grape and a punch of fresh hop character

Hoppy Hazy IPA Day! 

For the uninitiated, Sierra Nevada had the brilliant idea to create a day of celebration for hazies back in 2023! This year, we’re excited to introduce our third iteration of the Hazy IPA Day badge. 

Whether you call it hazy, murky, blurry, or New England style, let’s raise our glasses to these heavenly hoppy ales!

beer.beer_description: Back in 2012 a brewery called Greenflash from San Diego created what may be the hoppiest beer in the world at the time. This is our ode to that beer. 9 ALC/VOL and 250 theoretical IBUs (because your taste buds struggle to register anything over 100 IBU but we wanted to give it a crack). Bitter beers may have fallen out of fashion, but we have loaded this beer with Columbus, Moutere, Centennial, Nelson Sauvin and Cryo Simcoe to give you a full on assault to the sensesâ€”so many hops it will weaken even the most sturdy wooden pallet!
